personality_one_liner: A premium, trustworthy SaaS tool that balances crisp data density with the earthy, warm nature of dairy farming.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Clear grouping of elements. Avoid dense dashboards by relying on scrolling and whitespace.

do's: Featured daily milk card background over faint farm imagery
dont's: Every single card in a long scrolling list

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Launch screen conveying trust and earthiness.

states.loading: Full-bleed 'hero_farm' image with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. Centered logo and app name.

screens.layout: Full-screen flex container. Use expo-linear-gradient as a scrim over the background image to ensure the logo and text are readable.

screens.name: Auth

states.error: Inline error text below the mobile number input.

screens.layout: Use a bottom-sheet-like layout anchored to the bottom. The top half is the 'hero_farm' image blurred. The bottom half is a solid surface card containing the phone number input and 'Send OTP' button.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard displaying daily milk metrics and quick logging actions.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the Today's Overview cards.
states.empty: Illustration ('milk_splash') encouraging the user to log today's first batch.
states.error: Error banner with a 'Retry' button to fetch metrics.

screens.layout: Header with Farm Name and Profile icon. Top section: A large 'Hero Card' (glassmorphism over a subtle farm background) displaying 'Today\'s Milk Overview': Produced, Delivered, Remaining, and Used. Below: A horizontally scrolling list of quick actions. A sticky Floating Action Button (FAB) at the bottom right for 'Log Milk'.

screens.name: Products
screens.purpose: Manage dairy product inventory (Ghee, Butter, Paneer, Curd, etc.).

states.empty: Empty state illustration with text 'No products added yet'.

screens.layout: 2-column grid layout with 'space-between' and 'md' gap. Each card shows an icon inside a brandTertiary container, the product name, current stock amount, and a subtle '+' button to add stock.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Monthly review of revenue and net profit.

states.empty: Message stating 'Not enough data to display analytics yet'.

screens.layout: Sticky header with a Segmented Control to toggle between 'Milk' and 'Dairy Products'. Below: Oversized typography for Total Revenue and Net Profit (incorporating the iOS-Native Clean rhythm). Simple line/bar chart using a clean charting library. Vertically scrollable.

screens.name: Broadcast
screens.purpose: Compose and send bulk WhatsApp messages to customers.
screens.layout: Top section: A text area for the message body. Middle section: A searchable list of customers with checkboxes to select recipients. Bottom: A sticky CTA 'Send via WhatsApp' anchored above the safe area.

hero_farm.alt: Serene brown cow in a green pasture, representing the dairy farm.

milk_splash.alt: Elegant splash of fresh milk in a clear glass.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a custom SVG-like logo using @expo/vector-icons. Combine '<MaterialCommunityIcons name="cow" />' with a subtle leaf or water drop to create a farm/dairy mark. DO NOT use emojis.
The color palette replaces standard AI-blues with warm, earthy tones (Deep Moss Green and Terracotta). Strictly stick to these tokens.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' via expo-font for a crisp, legible, numbers-friendly SaaS look. Keep font weights at 400 and 500.
Implement 4 bottom tabs: Home, Products, Analytics, Broadcast. The Profile screen is pushed from the Home header.
When layering text over the 'hero_farm' or 'farm_sunset' images, always use a top-to-bottom expo-linear-gradient scrim from transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse to guarantee text contrast.
On the Home Dashboard, implement the 'Today's Milk Overview' as a glassmorphism hero card over a faint background image.
Products screen uses a 2-column grid. Ensure width logic is robust (`(screenWidth - 2*screenPadding - gap) / 2`).
Broadcast screen must feature a sticky primary CTA ('Send via WhatsApp') pinned to the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView, hovering over the scrolling contact list.
